identity.title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][state] Unify durable kernel state on redb

values.goal: Make redb the single production durable state authority for Runtime v3 kernel checkpoint and lifelog state.
values.required_outcome: Runtime v3 stores checkpoint bytes and lifelog entries through atomic redb transactions, restores across restart, rejects integrity/schema/corruption failures, and removes production checkpoint.json/lifelog.jsonl persistence.
declared_scope: focused Runtime v3 state persistence tests
authority_boundary: Use the existing COTS redb crate; do not introduce a second database, ORM, wrapper, or service.
Coordinate around active WP-12 #5344 exact head ca242a5ab96a43ea1ed1ca6a3fedd61bde2f8b6d; do not touch the #5344 worktree.
Do not write tracked files on main and do not use /private/tmp.
operator_constraints: never write tracked changes on main
use typed C-SDLC v2 lifecycle tools only
post-merge closeout must not block other implementation work
